description: OL W1c·S3 — H1 with the lane on. The core covers the whole question (zero gaps), so the lane writes ONE query over the slice, the checks pass it, and the door runs it under the caller's subject. The answer is the H1 answer with the lane's provenance beside it: provenance.lane = llm, the model, the SQL. The same question with the lane off is h1-answer, which stays at zero LLM calls.
invariants: the lane is what emit does when it is on; the verdicts do not change and nothing in it binds (OL-C11)
the door runs the query under the CALLER's subject, whoever wrote it (OL-C12)
a covered question costs exactly one LLM call and one door call

args.text: Zobraz náklady účtu 501001 v roce 2025 podle období

replies.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', e.booked_on) AS obdobi, SUM(e.amount) AS naklady FROM er.entity.cost_entry e JOIN er.entity.account a ON e.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.code = '501001' AND e.booked_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND e.booked_on < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', e.booked_on) ORDER BY obdobi
replies.note: costs of account 501001 per month of 2025
